He also advocated nuclear energy investments and stronger IMF scrutiny of global economic imbalances, reflecting the Trump administration’s push to reshape multilateral institutions around American priorities.

title: Nestle India Q2 Results: Standalone profit jumps 36% YoY to Rs 1,027 crore, revenue rises 20%
description: In the second quarter of FY27, Nestle India achieved a remarkable standalone net profit of Rs 1,027 crore, marking a substantial 36% increase from last year's Rs 753 crore. Revenue from operations soared to Rs 6,788 crore, a 20% rise from Rs 5,644 crore. However, despite these impressive results, shares fell by 7% to Rs 1,260 on the NSE, reflecting a mixed market response.

title: Indian bonds breathe easy as Treasury yields decline
description: Early Thursday, bonds issued by the Indian government saw slight upswings, influenced by a rally in US Treasuries. Despite this, concerns over liquidity, climbing interest rates, and mounting supply challenges have capped these hikes. Traders are curbing risk levels prior to a major debt auction, while rising domestic inflation fuels anticipations of a tougher monetary approach from the Reserve Bank of India, as evidenced by the expanding India-U.S. yield spread.
